summary: The render foundation: Forward+ on the desktop with gl_compatibility declared as the mobile fallback, a RenderProfile autoload that names the features the live method cannot do, one island WorldEnvironment resource and scene, a fixed isometric camera director, and a seven-shader material library the two procedural setpieces adopt in place of their flat StandardMaterial3D colours.

coordination.notes: Branched from origin/backend/b0-expedition-state at f5d26d1; merged trunk at bea81f0 mid-lane to pick up P1. game/project.godot is touched in three places only: the [rendering] block, one autoload appended at the END of [autoload], and a new [shader_globals] section appended at the end of the file (wind, wind_heading and motion_scale, which the foliage and water shaders read; nothing else in the repository declares shader globals, so the section is new rather than shared). AGENTS.md section 0, three times. (1) This lane had extended game/tools/capture_review_scene.gd to render a list of scenes in one process; P1 landed the same idea, better, in the same file. The merge conflict was resolved as P1's file whole and nothing of the P2 extension survives beside it. (2) game/scripts/review/elizabethan_port_town_review.gd existed only to look_at a camera; the rig now owns framing declaratively through its frame_target export, so that script is DELETED rather than left duplicating the rig. (3) The terrace lighting kit and the port town set each built their own Environment and their own sun; both now instance res://render/world_environment.tscn and set only the hour and the weather through its exported properties. Two edits fall outside the card's literal file list and are named rather than hidden: the port town set's Environment section gained a HarborBed and HarborShelf (a depth-shaded sea needs a bottom before it can be shallow), and the terrace review scene gained a shore, a sloped beach and a sea plane, each marked in its own metadata as review staging that is not part of the world cell. No world-cell geometry, collision, navigation, anchor or ID was touched. Two library materials have no caller yet and are not pretending otherwise: stylised_river.tres and placeholder.tres. Both are named deliverables of the card and both are held by the suite. One mistake is in this branch's history rather than squashed out of it: 6c024ee cut MSAA to 2x and dropped SSAO and SSIL to half resolution because a stale API reading said CI's capture job had overrun. It had not -- the run finished green, Forward+ under lavapipe, ten scenes at 1920x1080 in 2m41s -- so 166891c reverts the cut and says so.
